name: P&S Sheet Metal Miami
old_description: P&S International Supply Corp is a leading sheet metal manufacturing company for all your sheet metal supply needs specializing in HVAC ductwork. We offer laser cutting, welding, and installation services to provide a one-stop solution for all your HVAC needs, whether for new construction or property rehabilitation projects.
about:
P&S International Supply Corp operates from Miami, Florida, where it runs a sheet metal fabrication facility at 3740 NW 78th Street. The company’s founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The shop produces custom HVAC ductwork in round, spiral, rectangular, and oval profiles, along with elbows, offsets, transitions, roof curbs, and adapters. Primary processes include laser cutting, welding, and sheet metal fabrication, supported by multiple in-house laser machines. The facility handles projects from takeoffs and duct lists through manufacturing and, optionally, installation. A recent project, the 250,000-square-foot Elev8 Fun complex in Jensen Beach, involved the full mechanical scope including equipment. Nationwide delivery and worldwide export—frequently to the Caribbean, Virgin Islands, and Latin America—extend the shop’s reach.

Customers include HVAC contractors, mechanical construction firms, and developers on new construction and property rehabilitation projects. The company works directly from project plans, providing takeoffs, duct lists, and quotes to move jobs into fabrication. It also supplies sheet metal sheets and coils, mechanical equipment, air conditioners, and spare parts.

P&S positions itself as a single source for manufacturing, fabrication, and mechanical supply, offering either fabrication-only delivery or a full mechanical scope with installation primarily throughout Florida. In-house laser capacity and the ability to generate duct lists from drawings are cited as key differentiators.
